about.title: About 75 Degree AC- Houston
text: 75 Degree AC was founded in 2016 with a clear mission, to deliver reliable, efficient, and high-quality HVAC solutions for homeowners and businesses across the Houston, TX area. Our company brings years of experience in AC repair, heating service, HVAC installation, and system maintenance shaped by the needs of Houston’s climate.
Houston-born HVAC company founded in 2016. Our lead tech Kenny Ho handles installs and major repairs personally, with honesty and accountability on every job.
Independently owned and operated out of Houston, TX — not a franchise. Every call, quote, and follow-up comes from our local team.
